title: Palindrome Checker
description: Check if a string is a palindrome — reading the same forwards and backwards.

steps.title: Reverse a string
steps.description: Write a `reverseString` function that reverses a string using `.split()`, `.reverse()`, and `.join()`.

steps.title: Check if palindrome
steps.description: Write an `isPalindrome` function that returns `true` if a string is the same forwards and backwards.
hints: Compare the original string to its reversed version
Return true if they are equal, false otherwise

verification.successMessage: racecar is a palindrome, hello is not!
verification.failureMessage: isPalindrome('racecar') should be true, isPalindrome('hello') should be false.

steps.title: Case-insensitive check
steps.description: Make `isPalindrome` case-insensitive using `.toLowerCase()` so `"RaceCar"` is recognized as a palindrome.
hints: Convert the string to lowercase before reversing and comparing
str.toLowerCase() for JS, str.lower() for Python

verification.successMessage: Case no longer matters! "RaceCar" is a palindrome.
verification.failureMessage: isPalindrome('RaceCar') should be true, isPalindrome('Hello') should be false.

steps.title: Test multiple words
steps.description: Write a function that takes an array of strings and returns which ones are palindromes.

Loop through and check each one with isPalindrome
